budget.rationale: Measured at 668209 bytes on 2026-08-16 at the resolved data location; 2MiB leaves more than twice the observed SQLite database and sidecar footprint.

data.rationale: Resolved scenario data directory containing the SQLite offer graph, gate registry, append-only catalog audit, and SQLite sidecars.

service.name: offer-desk
service.description: The offer graph, its promotion gates, and what should be sold

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o offer-desk-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

data-backup-manager.description: Protects the resolved Offer Desk data directory through scheduled snapshots and recovery drills; it is not part of request handling.
data-backup-manager.degraded_behavior: Offer Desk runs normally when the backup manager is unavailable; protection is a scheduled operational concern and the board continues to report data-source availability explicitly.

money-ledger.description: Supplies actuals for the earned-versus-intended join on the board (OT-P1-002). Read-only and one-way: Money Ledger has no knowledge of offers.
money-ledger.degraded_behavior: The board marks its actuals source unavailable with a reason and the age of the last good reading, and every other ranking source continues to rank. Earnings are never reported as zero on account of an unreachable ledger, because zero is indistinguishable from an offer that genuinely earned nothing.
